programs.title: Iron Curtain: Life Under Soviet Occupation
programs.desc: A story about the Sovietization process, from 1944 to the construction of the Berlin Wall.After World War II, the countries of Central and Eastern Europe found themselves in the Soviet zone.The events that led to such a division of the Old Continent will be presented.Viewers will learn how it affected the everyday lives of citizens of these countries and what forms of resistance they encountered.Experts will explain the mechanisms of Soviet domination.There will be witnesses' accounts, interviews, discussions of scientific works and archives including propaganda films, home recordings and fictional stories.

programs.title: UFOs: Investigating the Unknown
programs.desc: New information about UFOs reinforces the need for explanations.Governments are being urged to be more transparent.The need to increase the participation of independent scientists and citizens in research is also emphasized.

programs.title: The Sum of All Cities
programs.desc: The authors will present the history of selected cities.They will reveal what lies behind the numbers determining population, cost of living, crime rates, temperature and GDP.

programs.title: Drain the Oceans 6
programs.desc: The sea depths hide many secrets.Scientists can unravel further mysteries thanks to groundbreaking research and modern technologies.Viewers can expect exciting expeditions to the underwater world.

programs.title: Lost Treasures of the Bible: Secrets of Faith
programs.desc: An attempt to answer the question whether the evidence that Jesus was a historical figure has survived to this day.The investigation begins in the Church of the Holy Sepulchre.There is a certain discrepancy here - in the 1st century, burials took place outside the city walls, and the church is located in the very center.Specialists will try to explain this mystery.In addition, they are looking for the Pool of Siloam, traces of the Last Supper and Bethsaida, an ancient settlement located on the Sea of ​​Galilee where the apostles Peter, Andrew and Philip were born.The miracles described in the Bible were supposed to take place here.
